questions.question: Four number triads have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the number triad that is different from the rest.
questions.solution:
Let us check through options.

1) (192, 384, 576)

Sum of 1st, 2nd and 3rd digit is 12, 15 and 18 respectively.

2) (352, 436, 646)

Sum of 1st, 2nd and 3rd digit is **10**, **13 **and** 16 **respectively.

3) (219, 438, 657)

Sum of 1st, 2nd and 3rd digit is 12, 15 and 18 respectively.

4) (327, 654, 981)

Sum of 1st, 2nd and 3rd digit is 12, 15 and 18 respectively.

Hence, (352, 436, 646) is correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** 

The pattern followed here is:

**Option 1 **→ (192, 384, 576)

192 × 2 = 384

192 × 3 = 576

**Option 3** → (219, 438, 657)

219 × 2 = 438

219 × 3 = 657

**Option 4** → (327, 654, 981)

327 × 2 = 654

327 × 3 = 981

**Option 2** → (352, 436, 646)

352 × 2 ≠ 436

352 × 3 ≠ 646

But **option 2 doesn't follow the pattern.**

**Hence, option 2 i.e (352, 436, 646) is correct.**

questions.question:
Three different positions of a dice are shown. Select the letter that will be on the face opposite to the one having 'A'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a35ba7000e6c3b5fd1e9922ad3ec241ffb014653e1c119b3b1f905520a0cfa68.png]
questions.solution:
**TRICK:**

In first and second dice, we have common element i.e. C

We will rotate the elements either in clockwise or anticlockwise direction to get the opposite paired elements.

On rotating the elements in clockwise direction, we get,

First dice - C, B, A

Second dice - C, D, E

Thus, we can say that A is opposite to E.

Hence, **E **is correct.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statement is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements: **

1. All singers are honest.

2. Some players are singers.

**Conclusion:**

I. All players are honest.

II. Some players are honest.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
The possible venn diagram is as shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98788f321011766e2f62519c46eee719032a5829617808c60aa95d429470bad9.png] 

Given conclusions:

I. All players are honest → False (All players are honest is a possibility but not definite)

II. Some players are honest → True (Some players are singers and all singers are honest. Therefore, some players, which are singers are honest)

Hence, **Only conclusion II follows **is correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

’Some’ is a subset of ‘All’. If in statements it is given that ‘All A are B’ then the conclusion ‘Some A are B’ would always be True. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2871ef400e3efbb1a729252c361ace4fe13f5488c4d2c0c010817416e6a436a3.png]

questions.question: After three years, the total age of a mother and son will be 50. The mother's age was 30 before three years. What is her son's present age?
questions.solution:
Mother's age before three years = 30 years

Mother's present age = 30 + 3 = 33 years

Mother's age after three years = 33 + 3 = 36 years

Total age of a mother and son, after three years = 50

Son's age after three years = 50 - 36 = 14 years

Son's present age = 14 - 3 = 11 years.

Hence, **11 years **is correct.
